g.data-hint: ♥ We — Tricky Word: The single "e" makes a long /ee/ sound.
♥ the — Tricky Word: The "e" doesn’t say /e/, it makes a soft unaccented "uh" (schwa) sound.
♥ by — Tricky Word: The "y" acts as a vowel making a long /eye/ sound, just like "my".
♥ the — Tricky Word: The "e" doesn’t say /e/, it makes a soft unaccented "uh" (schwa) sound.
